blocks.operations: Conv + 3x maxpool pyramid + conv

blocks.operations: C3: 1 bottleneck + fusion conv

blocks.name: Head classification/regression convs at 40x30 scale
blocks.operations: Shared convs split into cls/reg branches

blocks.operations: C3: 1 bottleneck + fusion conv

blocks.operations: Shared convs split into cls/reg branches

blocks.name: 20x15 grid generation for anchor-free head
blocks.operations: Range, add offsets, expand, reshape to grid

blocks.name: Concatenate multi-scale logits and apply sigmoid

blocks.name: DFL distribution to box offsets

architecture: YOLOv8-style object detector: CSP-like backbone + PAN/FPN neck + DFL-based head with anchor-free grids and post-processing
